title: JFK and Donald Menzel's clearances

tellings.quote: Well, you know, JFK was also extremely interested in astrophysics at Harvard and was close with Don Menzel, who was this famous UFO debunker, but who admitted to JFK that he held some of the deepest, you know, clearances across the board, CIA, NSA, and Navy.
Menzel happened to hold extremely high clearances at the NSA, CIA, and Navy.
tellings.difference: Leaves out JFK and the claim that Menzel admitted the clearances to him.
tellings.link_reason: Same claim: Donald Menzel held very high clearances at the NSA, CIA and Navy.

tellings.quote: So you have Don Menzel who's you know this kind of deep state spook you know friends with Vanavar Bush held all the clearances in the book.
tellings.difference: Adds his friendship with Vannevar Bush and calls him a 'deep state spook'; leaves out JFK.
tellings.link_reason: Menzel as a debunker holding the highest clearances matches the story about Menzel's clearances.

as_told.title: Donald Menzel, cleared insider dogmatically opposed to UFOs

plain: Donald Menzel, a Harvard astronomer famous for explaining UFOs away, held some of the highest security clearances there were, with the CIA, the National Security Agency and the Navy, and Michels says Menzel admitted this to John F. Kennedy, whom he knew through Kennedy's interest in astrophysics at Harvard. Michels tells this himself on three episodes without naming a source; the later two leave out Kennedy, and one adds that Menzel was friends with Vannevar Bush, the engineer who ran American wartime science, calling Menzel a "deep state spook." If true, it would mean the best-known public UFO skeptic was deep inside the secret world.
